claims: The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion officially releases worldwide on May 22, 2026.
Select local game stores will hold prerelease events, selling Build & Battle boxes early starting May 9, 2026.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion features over 120 cards.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion focuses on new Mega Evolution Pokémon ex such as Mega Greninja ex.
Prerelease/Early Access starts May 9, 2026 at participating Event Locator stores.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion's key products include Booster packs.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion's key products include Elite Trainer Boxes including GameStop exclusives.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion's key products include Booster Bundles.
Mega Greninja ex is the headliner of the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion.
